= lifecycle-platform 0.1.0

This native platform exports an application's readonly integer through its
actual platform ABI. Its target-built C host checks the value. Every consumer
application is built once from the selected platform bundle; the archived
runtime harness links that generated archive and runs it on its native target.
The negative application must return one, so an always-successful host fails
the fixture. Compiler/link errors return 125 and cannot satisfy that case.

Candidate installation URLs:

* platform: {platform-url}
